parameters.name: Modulation depth
parameters.description: CC 1: Modulation depth; 0: no modulation, 100: full modulation, >100: over modulation.

parameters.name: Relative modulation frequency
parameters.description: CC 12: Relative modulation frequency; 127 = 0.99 * note pitch, 64 = 0.5*note pitch, 0 = off.

parameters.name: ADSR decay time
parameters.description: CC 75: ADSR decay time; 0=0.0s .. 127=4.0s; firmware 1.2 onwards.

parameters.name: ADSR sustain level
parameters.description: CC 80: ADSR sustain level; 0:Mute .. 127:Max; firmware 1.2 onwards.
